title: 염업조합법 시행령 / queue:ADDENDUM:24455:20130323:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Organization of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 24455, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations) (1) through (60) Omitted.

(61) The Enforcement Decree of the Salt Industry Cooperatives Act is partially amended as follows:

In the part of Article 2 (1) other than its subparagraphs, Article 2 (2), Articles 4 through 6, and the proviso of Article 7, "Minister for Food, Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries" shall be replaced with "Minister of Oceans and Fisheries", respectively.

(62) through (76) Omitted.
